jobs_results.title: Junior Buyer - Gardening
jobs_results.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Junior Buyer to join our Gardening team within Buying & Merchandising, based in our Central Support Office in Lasswade. You will work alongside the Buyer/Senior Buyer to source and develop commercial ranges and unique products that will create the reason for customers to shop at Dobbies. You will work on developing relationships with suppliers to get the best range and commercial terms for Dobbies.


Responsibilites

Build and manage critical path with key business stakeholders
Develop supplier relationships to ensure product at best price and quality
Meet company KPIs on sales margin in specific area
Begin to understand supply chain and work to ensure stock availability
Review consumer buying patterns to help understand future trends
Ensure product launch in line with seasonal launch dates
Attend trade shows and visit suppliers, developing supply base to achieve competitive advantage
Regularly review performance indicators, such as sales and discount levels and propose actions
Attend trade fairs to assist in the selection and assembly of new collection of products
Write reports and forecast sales levels
Working within multi channel retailing, ensuring product is available and represented across all selling channels

Who we are looking for

Strong analytical skills
Commercial awareness
Creative with an eye for trends and future opportunities
Comfortable in negotiation
Ability to cope with the pressure of having to make important decisions and meet tight deadlines
Positive energy and a strong mind to succeed
Confident presentation style
Drive and determination
Numerical and IT proficient
A passion for retail
Can demonstrate our values at all times – we’re one team, getting better everyday. We bring a smile. We live and breathe gardens. We make it work for our customers.

What we offer

Holiday – enjoy a well deserved break with 33 annual leave days per year (pro-rata for part time)
Discount – treat yourself with generous uncapped discount across our stores with 50% off in our Restaurants, 25% off in the Garden Centre and 10% off in our food halls
Hybrid working – a combination of office and home working to help balance your work life balance
Pension – save for the future with our company contributed enhanced Group Pension Plan
Season ticket loans – spread the cost of travel with an interest free loan
Access to Stream – support your financial wellbeing, with ability to access earnings ahead of pay day, save for the future and financial advice
Access to Retail Trust – seek confidential support, access to a Virtual GP, free counselling service and discounted retail rewards with our employee wellbeing platform
Access to Dobbies Academy – continue your development with our eLearning platform and development programmes
Study assistance – invest in your professional development with funded courses and qualifications
The little things to keep you going through the day – free tea, coffee, and milk
Collaborative office space – with access to our wellbeing room, learning resources and even a book swap
Invites to our annual company conference, summer and Christmas social events

About us
At Dobbies, we’re proud to have a history dating back to 1865. We were founded by James Dobbie and are the only garden centre retailer to have stores in every nation across the UK.


Our passion and joy for gardens and plants is what makes us special. In our stores, we showcase this through own brand and branded products, concession partners and services. We champion garden living all-year-round.


Many of our stores feature a restaurant or coffee shop, where customers can enjoy refreshments or meals in a relaxed and welcoming environment.


We offer a calendar of events and experiences that bring people and communities together, and we have a national charity partner that both our colleagues and customers raise money for,


We’re committed to being a great place to work. We’re one team and we encourage our colleagues to be the best version of themselves, every day; to share their wins and celebrate success. Together, we make it work for our customers.

jobs_results.title: Buying & Merchandising Assistant
jobs_results.description:
Are you looking to kick-start a career in retail buying?

We have an exciting opportunity for a Buying & Merchandising Assistant to join our Cookshop & Utility team on a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover contract.

You'll be based at our Central Support Office in Lasswade, near Edinburgh, with hybrid working available.

We welcome applications from graduates and school leavers with A Levels (or equivalent Highers). Previous buying experience isn't essential. What matters most is that you're eager, keen to learn and passionate about building a career in Buying & Merchandising. This is a fantastic entry-level role to gain hands-on retail buying experience with one of the UK's best-loved garden centre retailers.

As a Buying & Merchandising Assistant, you'll support the Buying team and work closely with stores and suppliers. The role focuses on product data management, supplier liaison, sample management, maintaining the critical path for the Buying team and general administration. It's the perfect foundation for a future career as a Buyer, Merchandiser or Product Developer.

Hybrid working: our Buying & Merchandising Assistant role offers a mix of home working and working from our Central Support Office in Lasswade. You can choose to work in the office more often if you prefer, which is a great way to learn from the team.

jobs_results.title: Assistant Merchandiser - Garden & DIY
jobs_results.description:
At Argos, we’re a digital-led UK retailer that keeps pushing boundaries to meet every generation with what they want, how and when they want it. As a market leader in general merchandise, serving millions of customers through our website, app,  same-day delivery and Click & Collect services, we offer real opportunities to learn, grow and shape your career. With roles spanning Commercial, Buying, Merchandising, Design and Supply Chain, through to Digital, Operations, Customer Experience, Marketing, and People and Transformation , you will work with brilliant colleagues and directly shape how we serve our customers every day. From enabling inspiring choice across our owned brands, including Habitat, Chad Valley and Bush, alongside the world’s biggest brands like Apple, Lego, Xbox and Samsung, to making shopping effortlessly convenient, championing trusted value and accelerating our strategy - Argos is an exciting place to build your future.

Why join us

Joining our Merchandising team at Argos offers an exciting opportunity to excel in your career with a renowned brand. As an Assistant Merchandiser, you will be part of a dynamic team that strives to deliver customer-focused product ranges and achieve sales, profit, margin, and stock targets. With a focus on trend analysis and merchandising systems, you will play a crucial role in ensuring we have the right products to meet our customers' needs. Whether you already have experience in merchandising or are a graduate in a relevant field, we provide a supportive environment where you can develop your skills and progress. With a strong emphasis on work-life balance and a range of comprehensive benefits, joining us means being part of a team that values your contribution and provides opportunities for growth and fulfillment.

What you'll do

Joining our Merchandising team as an Assistant Merchandiser, you will play a vital role in supporting the delivery of customer-focused product ranges to achieve sales, profit, margin, and stock targets. With a keen eye for trend analysis, you will ensure that our product offering meets customer demands and expectations. In this role, you will review weekly trading performance, identify opportunities and issues, and provide relevant analysis. You will own and manage category and SKU level forecasts to optimise sales, stock holding, margin, and availability. Collaborating with the A&R replenishment assistant, you will plan initial allocations and launch builds to meet stock and availability targets. Your strong analytical and numerical skills, coupled with proficiency in using merchandising systems, will enable you to drive efficiency and maximise availability. Additionally, you will be responsible for order management, maintaining data integrity, and ensuring compliance with legal and sustainability requirements. With your proactive and positive approach, you will build relationships with stakeholders and contribute to the success of our team.

Who you are

As an Assistant Merchandiser for our Merchandising team, you are a driven and passionate professional who thrives in a fast-paced retail environment. With previous experience in an Assistant Merchandiser or Merchandise Admin position, or a relevant field graduate, you have a solid understanding of allocation and stock management. Your strong analytical and numerical skills, coupled with your proficiency in Excel, enable you to review trading performance, forecast sales, and optimise stock availability to achieve sales, profit, margin, and stock targets. With excellent organisational ability and attention to detail, you ensure the timely delivery of stock, manage order management processes, and maintain high levels of data integrity. Your proactive approach, willingness to learn new systems, and ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders make you a valuable asset to our team as we strive to deliver excellent customer-focused product ranges.

Essential Criteria 

Commercial background in a general merchandise areaPrevious experience in an Assistant Merchandiser or Merchandise Admin roleUnderstanding of allocation and stock management and forecastingStrong planning and prioritisation skills, Highly numerate and analytical  Ability to work within tight deadlinesLocation: Coventry SSC and Home (hybrid) 

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so youll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, theres always the chance to try something new-whether thats as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, well also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them:

Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. This increases to 15% off at Sainsburys every Friday and Saturday and 15% off at Argos every pay day. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related bonus of up to 5% of salary, depending on how we perform. 

Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance, and you can buy additional holiday. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, pay advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance programme.

Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks pay for paternity leave.

Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply).

Please note, due to the volume of applications we receive, our roles may close early.

As a Production & Mock Shop Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting Dobbies' Buying, Merchandising and Customer teams by ensuring the effective management, organisation and presentation of our mock shop environments. Working closely with Buyers, Buying & Merchandising Assistants (BMAs), the Customer team and wider business functions, you will help create inspiring and well-organised spaces that support product reviews, range planning, photography and promotional activities.   This is a varied, hands-on role within a fast-paced retail environment. You will take ownership of the day-to-day operation of the mock shops, including fixture builds, sample management, stock organisation and workspace maintenance. You will also support internal and external events, lifestyle photography shoots and customer-facing projects, ensuring products and displays are prepared, organised and available when required.   The role requires a proactive and practical individual who enjoys working collaboratively with multiple teams, managing competing priorities and maintaining high standards of organisation and presentation. This position would suit someone who is highly organised, physically active and interested in developing experience within retail operations, merchandising support and visual presentation.   Responsibilities     

 Managing and maintaining all mock shop environments, ensuring they are organised, safe, well presented and ready for use.  Supporting fixture builds, display installations and product set-ups for range reviews, presentations and business meetings.  Working closely with Buyers and Buying & Merchandising Assistants to coordinate stock and sample requirements for mock shop set-ups.  Receiving, processing, organising and storing incoming merchandise, samples and display materials.  Maintaining effective stock management processes to ensure products and equipment can be easily located and retrieved when required.  Supporting the collation, packing, transportation and return of samples for internal reviews, photography projects and external shoots.  Assisting with product picking, organisation and returns for in-house studio photography and content creation activities.  Supporting furniture assembly, set building and product preparation for lifestyle photography and marketing projects.  Assisting with sample sales and other business events alongside Head Office teams.  Maintaining storage areas, fixtures and equipment to ensure efficient mock shop operations and seamless set-up for Customer and Commercial teams.  Ensuring all Health & Safety procedures are followed and that workspaces remain clean, organised and compliant at all times.  Responding to email, telephone and face-to-face enquiries in a professional and timely manner.  Supporting external events, promotional activities and store-based projects as required.  Assisting the Visual Merchandising team with store implementations within the Edinburgh store when required.  Driving company hire vans to transport samples, fixtures and equipment between mock shops, stores, event locations and photography shoots.  Building and maintaining positive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.  Supporting continuous improvement initiatives and undertaking additional duties and projects as reasonably requested by the line manager.

 A highly organised and proactive individual with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.  A practical and hands-on team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced retail environment.  Strong communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively with colleagues across a variety of departments.  Able to build and maintain positive relationships with suppliers, stores and internal stakeholders.  Comfortable handling stock, samples, fixtures and equipment while maintaining high standards of organisation and presentation.  Committed to maintaining safe working practices and following Health & Safety procedures.  Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks and use initiative to solve problems.  Confident using Microsoft Office applications and managing administrative tasks alongside operational responsibilities.  Flexible and adaptable, with a willingness to support external events, photography projects and store implementations when required.  Comfortable undertaking manual handling activities, including lifting, building displays and moving stock and fixtures.  Holds a full, clean driving licence and is confident driving hire vans to transport products, samples and equipment.  Interested in developing knowledge and experience within retail operations, merchandising support, product presentation and visual merchandising.
